title: Coefficientwise extension of an integral polynomial to $\Ql$
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ for the field of
$\ell$-adic numbers, and fix an indeterminate $T$. For
$P(T)=\sum_{r\geq0}c_rT^r\in\mathbf Z[T]$, the coefficientwise
extension of $P$ to $\Ql$ is

$$
P^{(\ell)}(T)=\sum_{r\geq0}(c_r\cdot1_{\Ql})T^r\in\Ql[T],
$$

the image of $P$ under the ring homomorphism
$\mathbf Z[T]\to\Ql[T]$ that applies the unique ring homomorphism
$\mathbf Z\to\Ql$, $c\mapsto c\cdot1_{\Ql}$, to each coefficient and
fixes $T$.
